aboutGame.title: What is UPD Build An Empire?
paragraphs: UPD Build An Empire is a Roblox building and progression simulator where players start with a tiny piece of land and slowly turn it into a huge empire. Build farms, mines, houses, and castles, grow your population, produce resources, and keep getting richer.

Research upgrades to unlock stronger buildings and bonuses, then build an army with soldiers, Giants, Medics, and siege weapons. Fight other empires, capture flags, take control of the map, and upgrade your Empire Level to become the best.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about UPD Build An Empire.

items.question: What is UPD Build An Empire?
items.answer: UPD Build An Empire is a free-to-play Roblox building and progression simulator. You start with a tiny piece of land and grow it into a huge empire by building farms, mines, houses, and castles, producing resources, researching upgrades, and raising your Empire Level.

items.question: How do I make money fast?
items.answer: Focus on resource production first, sell high-value resources instead of stockpiling, and reinvest your coins into more buildings. Offline income keeps your empire earning while you are away.

items.question: How do I build an army?
items.answer: Build a Barracks and recruit soldiers, Giants, Medics, and siege weapons. Use your army to defend your empire, capture flags, and fight other empires for map control.

items.question: Where do I find active codes?
items.answer: Use the Codes page for working codes, rewards, expiration notes, and redeem instructions.

items.question: What should I upgrade first?
items.answer: Prioritize resource production, then the Research Lab for unlocks and bonuses, then population housing. Our Best Upgrades guide covers the full priority order.
